testCases.name: XSS Injection in className
testCases.actual: Safely caught: className contains unsupported characters.

testCases.name: HTML tag injection in label
testCases.actual: Safely escaped in aria-label: <span class="wavelo wavelo--ring wavelo--ring" data-wavelo-motion="auto" data-wavelo-theme="light" a

testCases.name: CSS Injection in color property
testCases.expected: Rejects CSS with semicolons or url()
testCases.actual: Safely rejected with LoaderConfigurationError: Invalid color: red; background: url(https://attacker.com/leak); animation: none;. Use hex, a colour keyword, or a function like rgb(), oklch(), color-mix().
testCases.evidence: Invalid color: red; background: url(https://attacker.com/leak); animation: none;. Use hex, a colour keyword, or a function like rgb(), oklch(), color-mix().

testCases.name: CSS Injection in style object
testCases.expected: Rejects semicolons or url() in style object values
testCases.actual: Safely rejected: Invalid CSS value for --wavelo-evil

testCases.name: Foreign ARIA attributes injection
testCases.expected: Rejects unmanaged aria-* or role properties
testCases.actual: Safely rejected: aria-live is not a Wavelo option. Use label, labelledBy, describedBy, valueText or decorative; the renderer owns role and aria-*.
testCases.evidence: aria-live is not a Wavelo option. Use label, labelledBy, describedBy, valueText or decorative; the renderer owns role and aria-*.
